career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official occupation extract gives the employer, title and 2003–2007 boundaries; Clare's current biography corroborates the role. Transurban's current corporate page identifies it as an ASX-listed company, supporting private control. Exact start/end dates, hours, leave and campaign transition are unresolved; the managerial title is not treated as proof of full-time work. First speech18February2008 recalls four years with Transurban.2006 report supports contemporary ASX listing, dispersed securities and corporate governance; no individual appointment/hours evidence located. Queensland Investment Corporation’s2.91% register holding is a minority investment, not evidence of government control.
career_spells.counting_note: Private control is supported, but year-only boundaries and unproven substantive full-time status do not support an exact headline duration.

career_spells.evidence_note: Secondary reporting records that Clare won Labor preselection in May 2007, and the frozen roster records the start of House service on 24 November 2007. Exact preselection day, campaign work dates, pay, hours and overlap with Transurban are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party and campaign activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster establishes House service from 24 November 2007. career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.

research_notes: The frozen official occupation extract supplies a continuous year-level sequence from 1995 to parliamentary entry, but does not establish exact transitions or working hours.
Transurban's ASX listing supports private control; a senior corporate title does not prove substantive full-time work.
The 1992–2002 party branch role overlaps study and political-staff employment and is not assumed to have been paid.
Ministerial offices held as an MP are treated as duties nested within elected office.

Systematic follow-up2026-10-01 added omitted part-time Woolworths and Sizzler work, confirmed1998 university graduation, resolved branch-secretary endpoint toward primary2001 with conflict preserved, and added relevant-year Transurban ownership/governance evidence.

Five student-work years and four Transurban years are rounded narrative durations, not exact calendar spells. Graduation is a dated educational milestone, not proof of full-time study or an adviser start/end. Trolley job year1987 explicitly stated by Clare; no birth-year arithmetic used.

Searched first speech, ministerial speeches/interviews, public social/profile evidence, UNSW alumni publication, official party history and Transurban2006 annual report. Annual-report text contains no Clare match; generic workforce and senior-executive terms cannot prove his hours. LinkedIn direct profile unavailable; no access controls bypassed.

Follow-up priorities: named payroll employers/store operating entities, precise student-work intervals, Whelan/Carr contracts and leave, Transurban entry/exit and campaign leave. Law degree does not prove practising solicitor employment. No source establishes a countable full-time interval; advance national queue.

Second follow-up 2 October 2026: no material enrichment. Targeted Transurban resignation, campaign leave, personal full-time status, Whelan appointment, public professional profile and Sizzler year searches returned the existing year-level sequence and five-year student-job recollection. No primary evidence narrowing individual employment boundaries or hours located.

ABC election-page full-time phrase belongs to a different candidate, not Clare. Generic Transurban workforce classifications and a law qualification do not prove personal hours or solicitor employment. Profile-only result gives current office without historic months. Reconfirmed Sizzler transcript does not permit mapping five years to degree dates. Retain gaps and advance; next useful evidence is individual Transurban appointment/cessation or leave notice and student-job payroll records.

Third follow-up 2026-10-04: targeted exact-name searches for Transurban appointment/cessation, corporate-relations work, Paul Whelan service and 2007 campaign overlap repeated the official year-level sequence and public professional-profile summary. No original individual personnel, leave, hours or narrower boundary evidence was located. A derivative database’s 1 January placeholders were rejected as conversions of year-only dates. No material enrichment counted; advance pending a Transurban personnel notice, campaign-leave record or staff appointment file.
